+  # Import parsed commands into the database
+  #
+  # Note: Path tracking is NOT performed on imported commands because:
+  # - Shell history files store raw arguments, not absolute paths
+  # - Path tracking requires absolute paths that currently exist
+  # - This ensures consistency and accuracy of path data
+  #

   db.results_as_hash = true
   imported_count = 0
 
+  # Create lookup dictionaries to map original IDs to new database IDs
+  command_id_lookup = {}

+
